title: Compact decision transcripts + adaptive per-hop metrics for smart routing observability
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add compact decision transcripts and an adaptive per-hop metrics layer to improve explainability and reduce telemetry cost for smart routing (region selection, tier routing, fallback variants). Goals: capture enough provenance to debug routing outcomes and SLO regressions while keeping telemetry size and egress low for high-volume traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Decision transcript schema defined and documented (compact JSON schema + field dictionary)
Per-hop metric collector implemented with adaptive sampling controls (headroom + anomaly modes)
End-to-end pipeline: capture -> compress -> store indexable transcripts in trace store for 90 days
Console surface (per-route) displays compact decision counts, highest-frequency fallback reasons, and sampled transcripts
Cost impact evaluated and within target (<= 12% telemetry cost increase for 95th percentile workload)
Security review completed and PII redaction rules enforced
tasks: Draft compact transcript schema and field tagging rules
Implement lightweight per-request provenance header (routing decisions, model variant hash)
Add adaptive sampling controller (rate + anomaly-triggered spike capture)
Wire transcripts into existing trace store with compression codec and index keys
Expose aggregate metrics in Console and add drill-down to sampled transcripts
Run load test to measure telemetry bandwidth and CPU overhead
Prepare security review doc and redaction matrix

risks_and_tradeoffs: Payload choices: verbose JSON is easy to query but increases cost; using msgpack+zstd reduces size but requires decoder in analysis tooling
Sampling policy complexity: fixed-rate sampling is simple but misses rare cascades; adaptive sampling catches anomalies at cost of bursty telemetry
Privacy: storing even hashed identifiers increases re-identification risk if combined with other logs; enforce strict retention and HMAC salts
Operational: indexing sampled transcripts requires extra index shards — plan to colocate index with trace store to avoid cross-region egress
